title: Licandza
description: Ingwenya, Lufudvu, Iphengwini neNkhukhu batfole licadza. Ngabe licandza labo? ‘Licandza letfu,’ kusho lomake nababe labatigcabhako ekugcineni. Tfola kutsi ngabe lelicandza labani.
